# CUAD mini fixture

These three contracts are the smallest PDFs from distinct contract-type strata in CUAD v1. They are copied
deterministically by `python scripts/download_cuad.py --create-fixture` and are used only by fast local tests.

Source: The Atticus Project, [Contract Understanding Atticus Dataset (CUAD) v1](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4595826),
licensed under CC BY 4.0. The CUAD documentation notes that the underlying contracts are public SEC EDGAR filings
and makes no representation about their license status.
